mechanisms.additional_defects: ~0.1% missing onset; ~0.1% report before onset; ~0.1% invalid ICD
mechanisms.reporting: Right-skewed 0–21d delay, Friday/Saturday and selected fixed-holiday reporting dips; five Dhaka facilities silent three weeks then backfill
mechanisms.severity: Disease-specific admissions/lab probabilities; admissions rise during injected outbreaks; deaths nested within admission
mechanisms.limitations: Constructed mechanisms for testing analytics, not a fitted epidemiological model or clinically validated disease burden. Fixed national holidays are illustrative and exclude lunar holiday dates. Synthetic 90+ ages are uniform 90..100. Stock quantities and treatment conversion are teaching assumptions, not procurement advice.
